cells.gaps: No source puts a woreda administration's office outside Addis Ababa on a connection provided to it: the 592 woreda offices recording transactions in IFMIS (2018, ETH-012/013) have no connection stated and no total, and a 2021 fact (ETH-011) says IFMIS is not yet fully functional at woreda level, so the two disagree. The 444 of 492 safety net woredas (ETH-015/016) and the woreda health offices (ETH-009/010) are ministries' sector offices and carry nothing; the only finance fact (ETH-018, donor) is the safety net system's, so finance for the cell is not stated, and no plan naming the connection of woredas is held.
cells.note: The one institutional connection on record is Addis Ababa's central-to-woreda connectivity, described as a pilot in the capital only (December 2025), which is stage 2. Stage 3 needs an institutional connection live in local governments outside the capital, and no fact states one.
